name: Tremendous Extractor
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo xargs apt-get install -y -qq < packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt;
postAttachCommand: bash setup.sh && streamlit run app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
